modelName: One ME, end to end — the whole process and which tools carry each step today
modelNote: Section 9 of the RCN Design Record: Marc asked for a diagram of the whole process, created with the RCN Graph Tool, and for a clear statement of what 'RCN foundational tools fully operational' currently means. This is both. Read left to right, top to bottom: a scenario becomes an ME, the ME is seeded, works, is settled, and leaves traces. Each step is colored by the state of the tool that carries it as of 2026-09-11: green = built and usable today; amber = exists but needs extension for this use; red = not built, done by hand. The design is fully operational when every step is green. Built 2026-09-11 by Marc Pierson and Claude. PROVENANCE: the process is Section 8's formation sequence; the tool states are Claude's reading of the rcn repository on the date above and should be corrected by Marc.

legendEntries.label: Exists, needs extension for this use
Not built — done by hand for now
A durable object that outlives the ME

nodes.label: Green: built. Amber: exists, needs extension. Red: by hand. The design is operational when every box is green — and it can be run end to end by hand, at small scale, today.
nodes.note: Marc, Section 9 edits: 'We really need to DO all of this in a very small test end to end ASAP creating or simulating missing pieces as we go.'

nodes.label: SCENARIO
nodes.note: Compound-need or vision-blueprint, written on the Customer Scenario template in FedWiki (built). Section 5.

nodes.label: e-VSM BEFORE
nodes.note: Survey the neighborhood on the 11 spheres before the work. Built: evsm-svg-v3, aggregator, Claude synthesis. Section 3.

nodes.label: EIP STAGE SKETCH
nodes.note: Sketch the ecosystem in front of the people concerned. EIP mode exists in the Graph Tool; the stage underlay, storyboard and print path are on docs/eip-stage-todo.md. Section 8.

nodes.label: VALUE NETWORK
nodes.note: Draw what moves between the roles today and what ought to and does not. Built: VNA legend preset + validator rules. Section 8, Section 9.

nodes.label: WEIGHTED SELECTION
nodes.note: Choose which scenarios to seed, with decision-making distributed across participants. The 2014 matrix exists on paper; no RCN tool yet. Marc: Vester's sensitivity model could serve here too. Section 9.

nodes.label: VAM
nodes.note: Who gets what share, in which currency, within what limits, when residents recognize value. Written by hand against the value network. No tool; the research on neighborhood VAMs is not done. Section 6, Section 9.

nodes.label: CHARTER
nodes.note: Named promises, offers, institutional commitments, the Platform's seed commitment, the scenario declared. CfA-dSC exists for dyadic conversations for action; the multi-party charter with VAM and gates is the committed enhancement. Section 7, Section 8.

nodes.label: SEED + GATES
nodes.note: Catalytic seed capital released against gates (Haier's three thresholds, adapted): launch, a first showing of recognized value, self-sustaining metabolism. By hand until CfA-dSC carries it. Section 9.

nodes.label: THE WORK
nodes.note: The ME executes at zero distance to residents, with conversations for action tracked. CfA-dSC tracks dyads today; the ME's whole web of promises is the extension. Section 8.

nodes.label: SCORECARD + RASCH
nodes.note: The neighborhood's own measures, calibrated with Rasch where there are enough respondents. CAM item pool drafted, not fielded; Rasch-on-e-VSM integration not started. Section 10.

nodes.label: e-VSM AFTER
nodes.note: Survey again on the same 33 pairs; compare with before. Built. Section 3, Section 8 retrospective.

nodes.label: SETTLEMENT
nodes.note: Residents' recognition declared; the VAM pays out in four currencies; a return share cycles to the Platform where revenue exists. By hand. Section 8, Section 9.

nodes.label: PORTFOLIOS
nodes.note: Each participant's SODOTO portfolio gains an entry: ME, role, resident attestations. SODOTO carries teaching badges today; ME participation and attestations are the committed extension. Section 8.

nodes.label: SCENARIO, ENRICHED
nodes.note: What was tried, what worked, what the next ME should know — written back whether the ME succeeded or failed. Built: FedWiki. Section 5.

nodes.label: ONE GRAPH
nodes.note: Every step leaves a trace in the Neo4j graph the RCN Workbench reads: scenarios, surveys, drawings, charters, portfolios. Loaders exist for drawings and value networks; the rest is to come. Section 8 — the RCN Workbench.

edges.label: return share cycles to the next launch
gate: recognized value, or the seed stops
